title: EF 142 or EF 151 or EF 157 (Introduction to Physics and Modeling for Engineers II)
description: A first engineering physics course: kinematics, Newton's laws, work and energy, and momentum, taught with an introduction to engineering problem solving, modeling, and teamwork.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's Engineering Fundamentals physics (EF 142 is the second half of the slower EF 141/142 sequence; EF 157 is Honors). Official descriptions are in data/raw/utk/courses/.

title: MATH 132 or MATH 141 or MATH 147 (Calculus 1B Infused with Precalculus)
description: A first calculus course: limits, derivatives and their applications, and an introduction to integrals.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's Calculus I (MATH 141), its Honors version (147), or the second half of the slower precalculus-infused sequence (132). Official descriptions are in data/raw/utk/courses/.

title: EF 152 or EF 158 (Physics for Engineers II)
description: A second engineering physics course, typically covering rotation, oscillations, waves, fluids, and thermodynamics, with engineering applications.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's EF 152 or its Honors version EF 158.

title: MATH 142 or MATH 148 (Calculus II)
description: A second calculus course: techniques and applications of integration, sequences, and series.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's MATH 142 or its Honors version MATH 148.

title: MATH 251 or MATH 257 (Linear Algebra I)
description: A first linear algebra course: systems of linear equations, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, and eigenvalues.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's MATH 251 or its Honors version MATH 257.

title: Select one: BIOL 101, BIOL 104, BIOL 150, PHYS 231, CHEM 128, CHEM 102, CHEM 122
description: A natural science course, in biology, chemistry, or physics, often with a laboratory.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's biology, chemistry (lecture with lab), or physics options.

title: COSC 303 or COSC 308 (Algorithms)
description: A course on the design, analysis, and implementation of data structures and algorithms, with a programming focus.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's COSC 303 or its Honors version COSC 308, taken with the lab COSC 304.

title: COSC 311 or COSC 317 (Discrete Structures)
description: A discrete mathematics course for computer science: sets, functions, relations, logic, and proof techniques.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's COSC 311 or its Honors version COSC 317.

title: Global Citizenship - United States (GCUS) Elective
description: A general education course on the United States: its history, government, society, or cultures.
notes: UTK: chosen from the Volunteer Core list.

title: Social Sciences Elective
description: A general education course on how individuals, groups, and societies behave, from a field such as psychology, sociology, economics, or political science.
notes: UTK: chosen from the Volunteer Core list.

title: COSC 360 or COSC 367 (Systems Programming)
description: A systems programming course in C: memory and process layout, system calls, files, and process management.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's COSC 360 or its Honors version COSC 367.

title: Select one: ECE 313, ECE 317, STAT 251, MATH 323
description: A calculus-based course in probability and statistics: random variables, distributions, expectation, and an introduction to statistical inference.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's probability and statistics options.

title: Computer Science Upper-Division Elective
description: An upper-level computer science or computer engineering course chosen by the student.
notes: UTK: any 3XX or 4XX COSC or ECE course not already required.

title: Arts and Humanities (AH) Elective
description: A general education course in the arts or humanities, such as literature, philosophy, history, art, or music.
notes: UTK: chosen from the Volunteer Core list.

title: COSC 325 or COSC 361 or COSC 362 (Introduction to Machine Learning)
description: An upper-level systems or intelligent-systems course: machine learning, operating systems, or computer networks.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's COSC 325, 361, or 362. Official descriptions are in data/raw/utk/courses/.

title: Global Citizenship - International (GCI) Elective
description: A general education course on cultures, societies, or issues outside the United States.
notes: UTK: chosen from the Volunteer Core list.

title: ENGL 355 or ENGL 360 (Rhetoric and Writing)
description: An upper-division writing course: rhetoric and argument, or technical and professional writing.
notes: Choice slot: UTK's ENGL 355 or ENGL 360.

title: Expanded Perspectives Elective
description: A general education course chosen from a broad list of areas, used to round out the general education requirements.
notes: UTK: chosen from the Volunteer Core list.

title: Engaged Inquiries (EI) Elective
description: A general education course that applies knowledge through inquiry, such as research, service, or problem-based learning.
notes: UTK: chosen from the Volunteer Core list.
